blocks.text: Egalik olmoshlari: my, your, his, her, its, our, their

O'zbekchada egalik ikki joyda ko'rinadi: «**mening** kitob**im**». Ko'pincha olmosh tushib qoladi, lekin qo'shimcha qoladi: «kitob**im**», «ism**ingiz**», «uy**imiz**». Ingliz tilida egalik qo'shimchasi yo'q. Egalikni faqat otdan **oldin** turgan so'z bildiradi: **my** book, **your** name, **our** house. Shuning uchun inglizchada egalik olmoshi **tushib qolmaydi**: «Ismingiz nima?» — What's **your** name? («What's name?» emas).

Egalik olmoshi doim otdan **oldin** turadi va hech qachon o'zgarmaydi: **my** book — **my** books (ko'plikda ham my). Undan oldin artikl qo'yilmaydi: «the my car» emas — **my car**; «a my friend» emas — **a friend of mine** (→ 61-dars). Ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, tartib: egalik olmoshi + sifat + ot — **my** new phone, **our** old house.

items.text: **Our** new flat is near the metro.

blocks.text: O'zbekchada «uning» hammaga bir xil. Ingliz tilida esa egasi erkak bo'lsa — **his**, ayol bo'lsa — **her**, narsa yoki hayvon bo'lsa — **its**, egalari bir nechta bo'lsa — **their**. Eng muhimi: tanlov **egaga** bog'liq, narsaga emas. «Azizning singlisi» — egasi Aziz (erkak), demak **his** sister. «Madinaning akasi» — egasi Madina (ayol), demak **her** brother. Narsaning o'zi erkakmi, ayolmi — ahamiyatsiz.

**her** ikki vazifada keladi. To'ldiruvchi sifatida: I called **her** — unga qo'ng'iroq qildim (→ 59-dars). Egalik sifatida: I called **her** mother — uning onasiga qo'ng'iroq qildim. Farqi: egalik **her** dan keyin doim ot keladi.

**its** — egalik olmoshi («uning»), narsa, hayvon, shahar, kompaniya haqida; unda apostrof **yo'q**: The cat is eating **its** food. **it's** — qisqa shakl: it is yoki it has: **It's** late (= it is). **It's** got a big garden (= it has). Ikkalasi deyarli bir xil eshitiladi, shuning uchun yozuvda ko'p adashtiriladi. Tekshirish usuli: gapga «it is» ni qo'yib ko'ring — mazmun chiqsa, **it's**; chiqmasa, **its**.

rows: The town is proud of **its** history.

items.text: Bukhara is famous for **its** old mosques.

blocks.text: Tana a'zolari, kiyim va oila: egalik olmoshi shart

O'zbekchada «Qo'limni yuvdim», «Boshim og'riyapti», «Paltongni kiy» — egalik faqat qo'shimchada. Inglizchada tana a'zolari, kiyim va oila a'zolari oldida egalik olmoshi qo'yiladi: I washed **my** hands (the hands emas), **She** broke **her** leg, Put on **your** coat, I love **my** family. Bu yerda the yoki hech narsa qo'yish — xato.

items.text: I brush **my** teeth twice a day.

blocks.text: Adashtirmang: their / there / they're, your / you're

rows: u yerda; there is / are — bor

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Aziz and her sister» → **Aziz and his sister** (egasi erkak); «Madina and his husband» → **Madina and her husband**; «I washed the hands.» → **I washed my hands.**; «I love family.» → **I love my family.**; «the my car» → **my car**; «Its cold.» → **It's cold.**; «What is you name?» → **What is your name?**
Eslab qolish: avval **egasini** toping. Erkak — **his**, ayol — **her**, narsa yoki hayvon — **its**, ko'plik — **their**. Narsaning o'zi ahamiyatsiz.
Bog'lanish: I / me, he / him — 59-dars. Otsiz ishlatiladigan shakllar (mine, yours, hers — «meniki», «sizniki», «uniki») — 61-dars. Ism bilan egalik (Aziz**'s** car — Azizning mashinasi) — 64-dars.

examples.title: **my** and **your**
examples.description: **my** — «mening» (`-im`), **your** — «sening / sizning» (`-ing` / `-ingiz`). O'zbekchada qo'shimcha yetarli, inglizchada otdan oldin egalik olmoshi shart.

sentences.text: What's **your** name? — **My** name's Bekzod.
I can't find **my** phone. Have you seen it?
Excuse me, is this **your** umbrella?
**My** sister works at a hospital in Samarkand.
Don't forget **your** passport — we're leaving in an hour.
I usually do **my** homework after dinner.
sentences.translation: Uy **vazifamni** odatda kechki ovqatdan keyin qilaman.

sentences.text: Could I borrow **your** pen for a moment?
**Your** English is very good! Where did you learn it?
In **my** free time I play football with **my** friends.
Children, put away **your** books and take out **your** notebooks.

examples.title: **his** or **her**? Look at the owner
examples.description: Egasi erkak — **his**, ayol — **her**. Tanlov narsaga emas, egaga bog'liq: Bekzod and **his** sister, Madina and **her** brother.

sentences.text: Aziz lives with **his** parents in Chilanzar.
Madina is in London, visiting **her** brother.
Tom loves **his** job, but he can't stand **his** boss.
sentences.translation: Tom **ishini** yaxshi ko'radi, lekin **boshlig'ini** ko'rarga ko'zi yo'q.

sentences.text: Sarah called **her** mum from the airport.
My grandfather can't read without **his** glasses.
Dilnoza and **her** husband have just bought a flat.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan **eri** yaqinda kvartira sotib olishdi.

sentences.text: Mr Brown always leaves **his** keys in the car.
Emma has got a little brother. **His** name is Jack.
Bekzod has a sister in Bukhara. **Her** son is a doctor.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning Buxoroda opasi bor. **Uning** o'g'li shifokor.

sentences.text: James forgot **his** wallet, so **his** girlfriend paid for dinner.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **hamyonini** unutib qoldiribdi, shuning uchun kechki ovqatga **qiz do'sti** to'ladi.

examples.title: **our** and **their**
examples.description: **our** — «bizning» (`-imiz`), **their** — «ularning» (`-lari`). their — egalari bir nechta bo'lganda: odamlar ham, narsalar ham.

sentences.text: **Our** flat is on the fifth floor.
The Smiths sold **their** house and moved to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Smitlar oilasi **uylarini** sotib, Oksfordga ko'chib ketishdi.

sentences.text: We really like **our** new neighbours; they're very friendly.
sentences.translation: Yangi **qo'shnilarimiz** bizga juda yoqadi, ular juda samimiy.

sentences.text: The students are waiting for **their** exam results.
Next summer we're spending **our** holiday in Khiva.
My grandparents keep all **their** old photos in a big box.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim barcha eski **suratlarini** katta qutida saqlashadi.

sentences.text: What do **their** children do? — **Their** son is a dentist.
sentences.translation: **Ularning** bolalari nima ish qiladi? — **O'g'li** tish shifokori.

sentences.text: In **our** family everybody speaks Uzbek and Russian.
Tourists often leave **their** bags at the hotel and walk around the old city.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar ko'pincha **sumkalarini** mehmonxonada qoldirib, eski shaharni aylanishadi.

sentences.text: Thank you for your help — **our** team couldn't do it without you.
sentences.translation: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat — **jamoamiz** sizsiz buni uddalay olmasdi.

examples.title: **its** or **it's**?
examples.description: **its** — egalik («uning»: narsa, hayvon, shahar), apostrofsiz. **it's** = it is / it has. Tekshirish: «it is» ni qo'yib ko'ring.

sentences.text: The dog is hungry. **Its** bowl is empty.
Take a jacket — **it's** cold outside.
Samarkand is famous for **its** beautiful old buildings.
I like this café, but **its** coffee is very expensive.
sentences.translation: Bu kafe menga yoqadi, lekin **qahvasi** juda qimmat.

sentences.text: **It's** been a long day, and I'm really tired.
sentences.translation: Bugun juda uzun **kun bo'ldi**, rosa charchadim.

sentences.text: The company has moved **its** office to the city centre.
Look at that bird! **Its** wings are bright blue.
sentences.translation: Anavi qushga qarang! **Qanotlari** yorqin ko'k rangda.

sentences.text: Where's my phone? — **It's** on the sofa.
This plant needs water — **its** leaves are going yellow.
sentences.translation: Bu gulga suv kerak — **barglari** sarg'ayib qolyapti.

sentences.text: **It's** a small town, but **its** people are very friendly.

examples.title: Body, clothes, family: **my** hands, **his** coat
examples.description: O'zbekchada egalik qo'shimchada («qo'limni», «paltosini»), inglizchada otdan oldin egalik olmoshi shart — the yoki hech narsa emas.

sentences.text: Wash **your** hands before dinner, please.
I've got a terrible headache, and **my** back hurts too.
Aziz fell off his bike and broke **his** arm.
Put on **your** coat — it's freezing!
Madina had **her** hair cut very short last week.
sentences.translation: Madina o'tgan hafta **sochini** juda kalta kestirdi.

sentences.text: James always takes off **his** shoes at the door.
We phone **our** parents every Sunday evening.
Close **your** eyes and make a wish!
Sarah is going to wear **her** new dress to the party tonight.
sentences.translation: Sara bugungi ziyofatga yangi **ko'ylagini** kiyib boradi.

sentences.text: My little brother is learning to tie **his** shoelaces.

examples.title: Questions and answers: What's **your** address?
examples.description: Savol → javob juftliklari. Savolda ko'pincha **your**, javobda **my**, **his**, **her**, **their**, **its**.

sentences.text: What's **your** surname? — **My** surname is Rakhimov.
Where do **your** parents live? — In Fergana; **their** house is near the bazaar.
Is that **your** car outside? — No, **my** car is in the garage.
What does **your** brother do? — He's a chef in **his** own restaurant.
How old is **your** daughter? — **Her** birthday is in May; she'll be seven.
sentences.translation: **Qizingiz** necha yoshda? — **Tug'ilgan kuni** mayda, yetti yoshga to'ladi.

sentences.text: Who is that man? — He's **our** new English teacher.
sentences.translation: Anavi kishi kim? — U **bizning** yangi ingliz tili o'qituvchimiz.

sentences.text: Where's **your** dog? — It's asleep in **its** basket.
Did you enjoy **your** holiday? — Yes, **our** hotel was right on the beach.
sentences.translation: **Ta'tilingiz** yaxshi o'tdimi? — Ha, **mehmonxonamiz** naq dengiz bo'yida edi.

sentences.text: Who's that girl with Tom? — That's **his** cousin from Leeds.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan turgan qiz kim? — U Tomning Lidsdan kelgan **amakivachchasi**.

sentences.text: Do you know **their** phone number? — No, but I know **their** address.
sentences.translation: **Ularning** telefon raqamini bilasizmi? — Yo'q, lekin **manzilini** bilaman.

examples.title: **he** → **his**, **they** → **their**
examples.description: Kishilik olmoshi va egalik olmoshi bitta gapda: **he** ... **his**, **we** ... **our**. Kishilik olmoshi fe'ldan oldin turadi, egalik olmoshi esa otdan oldin.

sentences.text: **He** lost **his** keys, so he couldn't get into **his** flat.
sentences.translation: **U** **kalitlarini** yo'qotib qo'ydi, shuning uchun **kvartirasiga** kira olmadi.

sentences.text: **They** cleaned **their** rooms before the guests came.
Every summer **we** go back to **our** village near Namangan.
Emma is very organised; **she** writes everything in **her** diary.
sentences.translation: Emma juda tartibli, **u** hamma narsani **kundaligiga** yozib qo'yadi.

sentences.text: Do **you** know where **your** ticket is?
**I** love **my** job, but **my** salary is low.
The boys are playing with **their** new ball in the yard.
When Aziz got home, **his** dinner was on the table.
sentences.translation: Aziz uyga kelganda, **kechki ovqati** stol ustida turgan edi.

sentences.text: My parents met **their** best friends at university.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam eng yaqin **do'stlari** bilan universitetda tanishishgan.

sentences.text: Our town is small, but **its** market is famous across the region.
sentences.translation: Shaharchamiz kichik, lekin **bozori** butun viloyatga mashhur.

examples.title: Mixed: possessive adjectives
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: barcha egalik olmoshlari, his / her tanlovi, its va oila a'zolari.

sentences.text: This is a photo of **my** family in front of **our** house.
On the left is **my** father, and next to him is **his** brother.
**Their** mother, **my** grandmother, is sitting in the middle.
The girl with the cat is **my** cousin Lola, and that's **her** cat.
sentences.translation: Mushuk ushlagan qiz — **amakivachcham** Lola, bu esa **uning** mushugi.

sentences.text: Students, please write **your** names at the top of the page.
Bekzod is proud of **his** daughter because **her** marks are excellent.
The museum is closed on Mondays, but **its** café is open.
sentences.translation: Muzey dushanba kunlari yopiq, lekin **kafesi** ochiq.

sentences.text: Sorry, I think you've taken **my** umbrella by mistake.
Our neighbours are on holiday, so we're feeding **their** cat.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz ta'tilda, shuning uchun **ularning** mushugini biz boqyapmiz.

sentences.text: When Grandma visits us, she always brings **her** famous apple pie.
sentences.translation: Buvim mehmonga kelganda doim **o'zining** mashhur olma pirogini olib keladi.
